comment: Category grouping + target-day matrix for the Production department dashboard (website/production.html, src/production/). Confirmed with the project owner against real DPR data on 2026-07-30 - see docs/production_dashboard.md for the full derivation and the Welding Finish rule this feeds into.
joint_threshold_comment: 'Total Joints' <= this value is the '<=8 Joint' bucket, otherwise '>8 Joint'. A blank/unreadable Total Joints defaults to the <=8 bucket (the smaller/safer target).
sb_comment: Any spool (any material, any joint count) whose 'Spool Size' is <= this value is SB, overriding the material/joint-count buckets below - checked BEFORE the zero-size fallback.
zero_size_fallback_comment: If 'Spool Size' is 0/blank AND 'Inch Dia' is 0/blank, the spool is placed in the 1st category (<=8 Joint Single Spool - CS/SS) regardless of its actual material or joint count, per the project owner's rule. This check runs BEFORE the SB check.

material_groups.comment: 'Material' (DPR 'Item Category Code') values that fall into the AS bucket. Everything else (CS, SS, DUPLEX, or any other/unrecognised value) falls into the combined CS/SS bucket - the target-day table gives CS and SS the same targets, so they are not split further.

pwht_comment: PWHT is deliberately not tracked here (per the project owner's instruction - not every spool needs PWHT, and it isn't in scope for this dashboard yet).

target_days.comment: Target day-from-Planned-Start for each stage, per category - the table the project owner supplied, confirmed against real DPR data.

welding_finish_fields.comment: Field names this module reads from the already-loaded Fabrication / Line History / Welding DB dataframes (see reader.ExcelReader, reused as-is - no column_mapping.json changes were needed).
welding_finish_fields.siop_comment: Fallback source of Planned Start (config/settings.json -> input_files.siop_planned) for spools the Weekly workbook's Master Planning Sheet has no row for. Only fills a gap - never overrides a Planned Start the Master Planning Sheet already provides, same rule the existing Projects pipeline's SIOP fallback uses. Reads the file's real column name ('Start Date') directly rather than via config/column_mapping.json's siop_planned section, which expects 'Planned Start Date' - a name that doesn't match either SIOP file seen so far, so that mapping has likely never actually renamed anything. Not changed here since it's shared with the Projects pipeline.
welding_finish_fields.prod_order_release_comment: Rule 0, same principle as the existing Projects pipeline's business_rules.py: a spool whose Prod Order Release date is blank hasn't been released to production yet, so it's excluded from this dashboard entirely (not counted in category distribution, ageing, or any chart) rather than showing up as a false 'missing Planned Start' gap. Confirmed with the project owner (2026-07-31): of the spools that looked like they had no Planned Start, the large majority (918 of 966 on his real data) were simply not yet released - only 48 were genuinely released with no Planned Start recorded anywhere.
welding_finish_fields.spool_details_comment: Weight and Quantity are read as-is from the DPR's own 'Total Wt' / 'Total Qty' columns, per the project owner's explicit instruction - no recalculation from unit weight x quantity or similar.
